business_problem: Guiyang Economic Development Zone needed a regional platform that could move hundreds of factories onto AI-assisted, cloud-connected operations so it could improve safety, maintenance, and energy efficiency while building a larger digital-manufacturing cluster.
solution_summary: Guiyang Economic Development Zone used Baidu AI Cloud's Kaiwu Industrial Internet Platform to create a zone-level operating layer for industrial digital transformation. The program targeted more than four hundred industrial enterprises and has already delivered device-cloud, data-processing, and enterprise-application services to over one hundred companies. On the shop floor, AI safety-inspection capabilities watch key areas and flag clothing or electrostatic-protection violations with instant red-light warnings, while temperature-and-humidity monitoring and cloud energy-control analysis track operating conditions and energy consumption. The same platform also supports maintenance workflows: when a connected enterprise sees an equipment alarm, it can upload fault photos so service partners can diagnose the issue and perform more precise repair. Together, these services make Kaiwu a shared industrial backbone for safety, efficiency, and ecosystem growth across the zone.

solution_components.name: Kaiwu Industrial Internet Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared industrial backbone that connects enterprises, data services, and operational applications across the zone.

solution_components.name: Industrial Internet + Safe Production
solution_components.role: Packages the zone's safety-production services on top of the platform for participating manufacturers.

solution_components.name: AI Safety Inspection
solution_components.role: Uses AI monitoring to identify unsafe workshop behavior and trigger immediate warnings.

solution_components.name: Cloud Energy Management Analytics
solution_components.role: Analyzes environmental conditions and energy consumption to support savings and more stable equipment operation.

data_flow: Equipment, camera, and environmental data from connected factories flows into the Kaiwu platform, where safety models detect violations and energy analytics evaluate temperature, humidity, and power use. Alarm photos and warnings are then routed to enterprise operators and maintenance providers so they can intervene, repair equipment, and optimize operating costs.
integration_points: Industrial enterprises in Guiyang Economic Development Zone
business_outcome: The zone gained a shared industrial-internet foundation that improves safety supervision, enables more precise maintenance, reduces energy costs for participating firms, and helps grow the broader regional manufacturing ecosystem.
